correctness.rationale: The unique indegree-zero cell (0,0) is distinguished. Every stable equitable colour class has identical rooted directed walk counts at all lengths, which in northwest-closed Young shape equal binomial(i+j,i) at rank i+j and zero otherwise. Along each diagonal this separates unordered cell coordinates; only transposes can share a class. If any off-diagonal transpose pair shares a stable class, in/out equitable predecessor and successor matching propagates to the origin boundary and then to all possible off-diagonal cells, forcing whole shape self-conjugate. Conversely transposition is a genuine digraph automorphism for self-conjugate shapes. Shared global histograms either match singleton colour-by-colour directed arcs or recover every unordered cell coordinate from the root-walk counts, proving relative fingerprint classification. Independent exhaustive refinement 271 Young partitions n≤12 corroborates.
